answer_1.quote: We collected three new datasets for benchmarking detection of AI-generated text across the domains of creative writing, news, and student essays.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates AI-written text corresponding to human-authored documents in creative writing, news, and student essays using ChatGPT and Claude, based on prompts derived from human-written text or generated prompts.

answer_2.quote: Our model obtains 99.0 F1 on in-domain classification, outperforming DetectGPT and GPTZero by an average margin of 23.7 F1.

answer_4.quote: Six undergraduate and PhD students with previous experience using text generation models were given a random set of 50 documents, evenly sampling human-authored and AI-generated documents, and asked to label whether the documents were written by a human or AI.
answer_4.guideline: Label whether the documents were written by a human or AI.
